summary: Invio is a self-hosted invoicing app (SvelteKit frontend with a Deno backend), seeded with data for an Amsterdam design studio. Signed in as admin through /login (recorded as the prelude). Saved 5 views, each opened directly by URL: (1) dashboard: stat cards for counts, revenue and statuses, plus a recent invoices table; (2) invoices: full list with status filter tabs and status badges; (3) invoice-detail: INV-2026-189 with action buttons, line items and status history; (4) invoice-editor: the edit form for the same invoice, with an editable line-items grid, totals, and tax and rounding options; (5) settings: sidebar of settings sections with the Company Information form. Skipped Users (a plain 5-row table, close to the other list layouts), plus Customers and Products, which are probably similar lists (not opened). Everything I tried worked.
